scope: Owned fixtures only; no private-source replay, old checkpoint migration or academic report/slides

verified_ci.scope: Service-free tests, dashboard browser fixtures and Kubernetes manifests; not real cluster execution

correctness_repairs.manifest_v2: Exact Parquet inventory, sizes, SHA256 and counts; missing/extra/changed objects rejected
correctness_repairs.source_replay: Validate full source binding before asset grouping; exact retries suppressed, conflicting IDs diagnosed
correctness_repairs.batch_retry: Full typed multiset comparison in both directions, not counts alone
correctness_repairs.checkpoint: New source-identity-v2 marker and isolated v8 layout; incompatible existing checkpoints rejected
correctness_repairs.legacy_limit: Manifest1.0 cannot retrospectively prove same-count historical integrity without an external oracle
correctness_repairs.completeness_limit: A wholly missing manifest requires an external expected inventory/completion barrier
correctness_repairs.identity_limit: Conflict detection is bounded by retained state and source-time policy, not timeless global uniqueness

changes: Reuse RIS counts and scoped verified materialization
Bounded Kafka ACK windows, default1 retained, contiguous progress only after complete success
Separate batch AQE/shuffle profile from fixed streaming checkpoint settings
Digest-pinned cached runtime with exact dependency-input checks

build_attempts.reason: Sustained new host swap activity; safety stop

build_attempts.qualification: Retained runtime/cache build only; not clean-machine dependency resolution

new_native_fixture_attempt.source: Existing config.snapshots owned fixture offsets0..5; no additional publication
new_native_fixture_attempt.failure: Three consecutive samples above16MiB/s new host swap-out; safety guard terminated owned active jobs/pods
new_native_fixture_attempt.causal_limit: Host-wide swapping observed; exclusive attribution to Spark or inherent VM capacity is not established
new_native_fixture_attempt.driver_log_limit: Pre-stop startup inspected; complete final driver log unavailable after guard termination

new_attempt_resources.metric: Kubernetes sampled working set and CPU, not process RSS or whole-job maxima
new_attempt_resources.qualification: Campaign spans idle/interrupted periods; not an elapsed-throughput benchmark or continuous whole-campaign resource claim

preservation_and_restoration.qualification: Fresh API/projection checks and readback of previously accepted fixture receipts, not acceptance of the corrected streaming image

course_gates.architecture: Previously executed single-node Lambda-style owned-fixture pipeline; not multi-node HA
